title: Help me put attack animations in my game

posts.author: Padrenho
posts.body: I'm creating a police game in RPG Maker and I was going to set it to have real-time shooting, but I changed my mind and I'm going to use normal battles but with animations, I want to add character animation shooting when you press the attack button and the enemies taking damage and also shooting them, I also want to change some things, like exchanging the elixir for a medkit that can be bought somewhere

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Have you done tutorials to learn how to use RPG Maker? Have you made practice games?
When you say
Padrenho said:
exchanging the elixir for a medkit that can be bought somewhere
Click to expand...
editing items in the database is
super
basic functionality. Like, that's not any kind of special technique, that's step one of a tutorial: open up the database tabs and change stuff.
The rest of what you're asking about is more complicated, and you'd need scripts for it. But Googling for those should take a back burner until you've learned how to use the default parts of the software.

posts.author: Padrenho
posts.body:
ATT_Turan said:
Já fez tutoriais para aprender a usar o RPG Maker? Você fez jogos de treino?
Quando voce diz
editar itens no banco de dados é uma funcionalidade
super
básica. Tipo, isso não é nenhum tipo de técnica especial, é o primeiro passo de um tutorial: abra as abas do banco de dados e altere as coisas.
O resto do que você está perguntando é mais complicado e você precisaria de scripts para isso. Mas pesquisar por eles no Google deve ficar em segundo plano até que você aprenda como usar as partes padrão do software.
